map.NICHQ Vanderbilt ADHD Diagnostic Rating: NICHQ Vanderbilt ADHD Diagnostic Rating Scale: assess ADHD symptoms and behavioral comorbidity in 6-18 yr children
map.提示：评分0=从不,1=偶尔,2=常如此,3=很常如此,4=非常频繁。ADHD诊: Note: scores 0=never,1=occasionally,2=often,3=very often,4=very frequently. ADHD diagnosis needs: inattention OR hyperactivity/impulsivity ≥6 items scored ≥2, onset before age 12, persistent ≥6 months, across settings (home+school), impairing function. Both parent and teacher scales positive. Exclude hyperthyroidism, sleep disorder, vision/hearing impairment etc. Treatment: behavioral therapy + medication (methylphenidate/atomoxetine). This is a screening tool; diagnosis needs specialist.
map.注意缺陷维度≥6 项阳性(0–4 分制≥2)→注意缺陷型阳性，需教师版交叉。: Inattention dimension ≥6 positive (0-4 scale ≥2) -> inattentive type positive, cross-check teacher version.
map.行为≥3 或焦虑≥3→对立违抗/焦虑共病，综合干预。: Behavior ≥3 or anxiety ≥3 -> ODD/anxiety comorbidity, combined intervention.
map.注意或多动维度≥6 项阳性、跨场景(家长+教师)、≥6 岁方可疑 ADHD。: Inattention or hyperactivity dimension ≥6 positive, across settings (parent+teacher), ≥6 yr -> suspect ADHD.
map.ADHD 需多场景表现，单场景阳性可能为情境性行为。: ADHD needs multi-setting presentation; single-setting positive may be situational.
map.多动症(Vanderbilt)量表评估器，NICHQ Vanderbilt量表评: The ADHD (Vanderbilt) scale assessor uses the NICHQ Vanderbilt scale to assess child ADHD symptoms and comorbid behavior problems. A medical professional tool based on authoritative standards, for reference only.
